crossRefs.note: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of…
Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of…
For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s…
“So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then…
But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her…
Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!

translations.web: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
translations.bsb: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
translations.kjv: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
translations.asv: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. And let the wicked be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise ye Jehovah.
